episodes.title: Open Your Essay With a Story
sources: UPSC Civil Services (Main) Essay paper pattern: two sections, two essays (one from each), 250 marks, 3 hours, about 1000-1200 words each; ClearIAS 'Essay Paper UPSC CSE 2022 Mains' (clearias.com) and Anantam IAS essay pattern page, read 2026-11-19 (secondary; official notice on upsc.gov.in)
The advice on openings is craft guidance written for this video, not a quoted source

quiz.q: How long should an essay-opening scene be?
quiz.why: The video calls a scene a doorway, not a room: four or five sentences.

quiz.q: What does the 'bridge sentence' do?
options: Links the scene to your topic
quiz.why: It turns the scene into the topic: this is not only a story about water, it is a question about who gets it.

quiz.q: In the Mains Essay paper, how many essays do you write?
quiz.why: The paper has two sections; you write one essay from each, in three hours.

episodes.title: Quiz: The 2022 Essay Paper
sources: UPSC Civil Services (Main) Examination 2022, Essay paper (16 Sep 2022): Section A and B topics and pattern, as reproduced by ClearIAS 'Essay Paper UPSC CSE 2022 Mains' (clearias.com), read 2026-11-19 (secondary; official paper on upsc.gov.in)
P. B. Shelley, A Defence of Poetry (written 1821, published 1840); Wikipedia 'A Defence of Poetry' and Interesting Literature summary, read 2026-11-19 (secondary)

quiz.q: In the 2022 Essay paper, the topic about a ship in the harbour was in which section?
quiz.why: It was Section A, topic 4 of the 2022 paper.

quiz.q: Where does the line 'Poets are the unacknowledged legislators of the world' come from?
quiz.why: Shelley wrote it in A Defence of Poetry (written 1821, published 1840).

quiz.q: What is a good first step when you read an essay topic?
quiz.why: The video's advice: find the tension (safety against purpose), argue both ends, finish on a balance.

episodes.title: Build Both Sides
sources: UPSC Civil Services (Main) Examination 2022, Essay paper, Section B topic 5 'The time to repair the roof is when the sun is shining', as reproduced by ClearIAS (clearias.com), read 2026-11-19 (secondary; official paper on upsc.gov.in)
The four-step method is essay-writing craft guidance written for this video, not a quoted source

quiz.q: In the 2022 Essay paper, which proverb-like topic did Section B carry?
options: Forests are the best case studies for economic excellence
The time to repair the roof is when the sun is shining
Poets are the unacknowledged legislators of the world
A ship in the harbour is safe
quiz.why: The roof line was Section B, topic 5 in 2022.

quiz.q: What is the third step in building both sides?
options: Give each side its best case
quiz.why: Four steps: state the claim fairly, best case for each side, find where they agree, offer a balanced way forward.

quiz.q: Before building your own side of an essay, what does the video advise?
quiz.why: Build the other side before your own, then a balanced way forward.

episodes.title: Five Indian Thinkers for Your Essays
sources: Thirukkural.net, History: 1,330 couplets in 133 chapters; three groups Aram, Porul, Kaamam, https://thirukkural.net/en/history.html (read 2026-11-19)
Kautilya, Arthashastra, tr. R. Shamasastry, Book I ch. 19, as excerpted at https://history.hanover.edu/courses/excerpts/261kaut.html (read 2026-11-19)
Belur Math, Swami Vivekananda's Speeches at the Parliament of Religions, Chicago, 1893, https://belurmath.org/swami-vivekananda-speeches-at-the-parliament-of-religions-chicago-1893/ (read 2026-11-19)

quiz.q: How many couplets does the Tirukkural have?
quiz.why: It has 1,330 couplets in 133 chapters of ten.

quiz.q: On which date did Vivekananda address the Parliament of Religions in Chicago, opening with 'Sisters and Brothers of America'?
quiz.why: The address was on 11 September 1893.

quiz.q: In his speech of 25 November 1949, what did Ambedkar say India was about to enter?
quiz.why: He spoke of 'a life of contradictions': equality in politics, inequality in social and economic life.

episodes.title: Quiz: Which Forest Grows It?
sources: NCERT Class IX, Contemporary India I, ch. 5 Natural Vegetation and Wildlife (2020-21 reprint), https://archive.org/details/ncert-iess1 (iess105, read 2026-11-19)

quiz.q: Which forest type is the most widespread in India and is also called the monsoon forest?
quiz.why: Tropical deciduous forests are the most widespread; teak is the dominant species.

quiz.q: Sundari trees, giving hard durable timber, are found in which forest of the Ganga-Brahmaputra delta?
quiz.why: Mangrove forests grow on tide-influenced coasts; sundari is the delta tree.

quiz.q: Rubber, ebony, mahogany and cinchona are commercially important trees of which forest?
quiz.why: These grow in tropical evergreen forests, with more than 200 cm of rain.

episodes.title: Quiz: Harappan Sites
sources: NCERT Class XII, Themes in Indian History Part I, ch. 1 Bricks, Beads and Bones (2020-21 reprint), https://archive.org/details/ncert-lehs1 (lehs101, read 2026-11-19)

quiz.q: Which Harappan site had the Great Bath on its citadel?
quiz.why: The Great Bath was on the citadel of Mohenjodaro.

quiz.q: Evidence of a ploughed field with two sets of furrows at right angles was found at which site in Rajasthan?
quiz.why: Kalibangan, in Early Harappan levels; the furrows suggest two crops grown together.

quiz.q: Which tiny settlement, under 7 hectares, was almost wholly given to craft production such as beads and shell?
quiz.why: Chanhudaro, against Mohenjodaro's 125 hectares.

episodes.title: Quiz: Rivers That Flow West
sources: NCERT Class IX, Contemporary India I, ch. 3 Drainage (2020-21 reprint), https://archive.org/details/ncert-iess1 (iess103, read 2026-11-19)

quiz.q: Which of these Peninsular rivers drains into the Arabian Sea?
quiz.why: The Tapi flows west; the other three flow east into the Bay of Bengal.

quiz.q: The Narmada and the Tapi flow west along which landform?
quiz.why: Both flow in rift valleys formed by faulting.

quiz.q: The Narmada and the Tapi are the only long rivers flowing west; what do they form at their mouths?
quiz.why: They make estuaries, not deltas.

Wikipedia, "Pitt's India Act", https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pitt%27s_India_Act (read 2026-11-19)

quiz.q: Which Act made the Governor-General of Bengal the Governor-General of India?
quiz.why: The Charter Act of 1833, when the Company also gave up trading.

quiz.q: Which Act created the Board of Control in London?
quiz.why: Pitt's India Act of 1784: the Board for politics, the directors for trade.

quiz.q: Which Act opened senior civil posts to competitive examination?
quiz.why: The Charter Act of 1853; the Macaulay Committee followed in 1854.

episodes.title: The Line That Sets India's Clock
sources: Wikipedia, "Indian Standard Time", https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Indian_Standard_Time (read 2026-11-19; secondary)
Wikipedia, "Kibithu", https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kibithu (read 2026-11-19): 28 deg 16'49"N 97 deg 01'04"E
Wikipedia, "Guhar Moti", https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Guhar_Moti (read 2026-11-19): about 23.7 N, 68.54 E, Kutch

quiz.q: What is the standard meridian of Indian Standard Time?
quiz.why: 82.5° E, which runs close to Mirzapur in Uttar Pradesh.

quiz.q: How far ahead of UTC is Indian Standard Time?
quiz.why: 82.5 divided by 15 is 5.5 hours.

quiz.q: Roughly how much earlier does the sun rise on India's eastern border than in the far west?
quiz.why: India spans nearly 30 degrees of longitude: almost two hours.

episodes.title: Quiz: Biosphere Reserves
sources: Drishti IAS, "Biosphere Reserves in India", https://www.drishtiias.com/daily-updates/daily-news-analysis/biosphere-reserves-in-india-3 (read 2026-11-19; secondary): Nilgiri first, 1986; core, buffer and transition zones

Wikipedia, "Biosphere reserves of India", https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Biosphere_reserves_of_India (read 2026-11-19; secondary): Simlipal in Odisha (Mayurbhanj), Nokrek in Meghalaya, Pachmarhi in Madhya Pradesh

quiz.q: India's first biosphere reserve, set up in 1986, is the...
quiz.why: Nilgiri, across Tamil Nadu, Kerala and Karnataka.

quiz.q: In which zone of a biosphere reserve do communities farm and carry on their livelihoods?
quiz.why: The transition zone, the outermost ring.

quiz.q: Which state holds the Simlipal biosphere reserve?
quiz.why: Odisha, in Mayurbhanj district.
